en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from his father Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Mughīrah, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān Al-Bazzāz, from ‘Amr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said, “Those who want to hold onto the ‘firmest handhold’ [2:256] of Allāh, which He has mentioned in His Book, should love ‘Ali ibn Abī Ťālib, Ḥasan, and Ḥusain (a.s.), for verily Allāh loves them on top of His Throne.”
